description: This source file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used to display log data from various sources by implementing the LogNode interface. It handles formatting and outputting log messages with different priorities and optional exception details, chaining log nodes for compound logging behavior.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface, formatting log data and handling threading concerns for UI updates.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message with associated priority, tag, optional Throwable, and chains the message to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string isn't null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
